title: Workspace Report Chart – Legend Not Updating After Filters (Frappe v15)

posts.name: Tasawar Hussain
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

While working on Frappe v15, I noticed an issue with Report Charts inside Workspaces:

  • The chart data updates correctly when applying filters.

  • But the legends do not refresh — they keep showing from the old cached dataset.

  • Also, when filters return no dataset, the chart shows empty space instead of a proper message like No Data Found.

I created a small patch JS file to fix both problems:

  1. Legends now refresh correctly whenever filters are applied.
  2. If the dataset is empty, the chart shows a friendly message:

Blockquote
No Data Available
No data found for the current filters or date range.
Blockquote

How to Use

  1. your_app/public/js/custom_chart_patch.js
  2. app_include_js = [“/assets/your_app/js/custom_chart_patch.js”]
  3. Reload your workspace.

I’ve also attached the custom patch script

/**
 * Targeted Chart Patch for Frappe v15 - Fixed Version
 * File: /public/js/custom_chart_patch.js
 * 
 * Fixes ONLY:
 * 1. Legend/labels not updating after filters (targeted fix)
 * 2. Better empty data handling without breaking existing charts
 * 
 * This patch is conservative and only intervenes when necessary
 */

$(document).ready(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (frappe.widget && frappe.widget.widget_factory && frappe.widget.widget_factory.chart) {
            patchChartWidgetTargeted();
        }
    }, 1000);
});

function patchChartWidgetTargeted() {
    const ChartWidget = frappe.widget.widget_factory.chart;
    
    if (!ChartWidget || !ChartWidget.prototype) {
        console.warn('ChartWidget not found for patching');
        return;
    }

    // Store original methods
    const originalFetchAndUpdate = ChartWidget.prototype.fetch_and_update_chart;
    
    // Only override fetch_and_update_chart to fix legend updates
    ChartWidget.prototype.fetch_and_update_chart = function() {
        this.args = {
            timespan: this.selected_timespan || this.chart_settings.timespan,
            time_interval: this.selected_time_interval || this.chart_settings.time_interval,
            from_date: this.selected_from_date || this.chart_settings.from_date,
            to_date: this.selected_to_date || this.chart_settings.to_date,
            heatmap_year: this.selected_heatmap_year || this.chart_settings.heatmap_year,
        };

        this.fetch(this.filters, true, this.args).then((data) => {
            if (this.chart_doc.chart_type == "Report") {
                this.report_result = data;
                this.summary = data.report_summary;
                data = this.get_report_chart_data(data);
            }

            this.update_chart_object();
            
            console.log("===============");
            console.log("Filter applied - New data:", data);
            console.log("===============");
            
            // CRITICAL: Store new data BEFORE destroying chart
            this.data = data;
            
            // FORCE CHART RECREATION to update legends
            if (this.dashboard_chart) {
                try {
                    console.log("Destroying existing chart for legend update");
                    // Destroy existing chart completely
                    if (typeof this.dashboard_chart.destroy === 'function') {
                        this.dashboard_chart.destroy();
                    }
                    this.dashboard_chart = null;
                    
                    // Clear container completely
                    if (this.chart_wrapper) {
                        this.chart_wrapper.empty();
                    }
                    
                    // Clear any cached chart references
                    delete this.dashboard_chart;
                    
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Error destroying chart:', e);
                }
            }
            
            this.render();
        }).catch((error) => {
            console.error('Error fetching chart data:', error);
            this.render();
        });
    };

    // Add conservative data validation - handles your data structure
    ChartWidget.prototype.hasValidChartData = function(data) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
            return false;
        }

        // Handle your specific data structure: {labels: Array, datasets: [{name: "", values: []}]}
        if (data.datasets && Array.isArray(data.datasets)) {
            if (data.datasets.length === 0) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Check if any dataset has valid data - handle both 'data' and 'values' properties
            const hasData = data.datasets.some(dataset => {
                const dataArray = dataset.data || dataset.values; // Handle both structures
                return dataArray && Array.isArray(dataArray) && dataArray.length > 0;
            });
            
            return hasData && data.labels && Array.isArray(data.labels) && data.labels.length > 0;
        }

        // For direct data structure (pie, donut charts) 
        if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) {
            return data.data.length > 0 && data.labels && Array.isArray(data.labels) && data.labels.length > 0;
        }

        // For heatmap data
        if (data.start && data.end) {
            return data.data && typeof data.data === 'object' && Object.keys(data.data).length > 0;
        }

        // If we can't determine structure, assume it's valid (conservative approach)
        return true;
    };

    // Override the original render method to ensure complete chart recreation
    const originalRender = ChartWidget.prototype.render;
    ChartWidget.prototype.render = async function() {
        try {
            // Check for completely empty data
            if (!this.data || !this.hasValidChartData(this.data)) {
                if (this.isDataCompletelyEmpty(this.data)) {
                    this.chart_wrapper.hide();
                    this.loading.hide();
                    this.$summary && this.$summary.hide();
                    this.showEnhancedEmptyState();
                    return;
                }
            }
            
            // CRITICAL FIX: Force fresh chart creation to update legends
            let setup_dashboard_chart = () => {
                const chart_args = this.get_chart_args();
                
                console.log("Creating fresh chart with args:", chart_args);
                
                // Always create fresh chart (don't use update method)
                this.dashboard_chart = frappe.utils.make_chart(this.chart_wrapper[0], chart_args);
            };

            // Hide loading states and show chart
            this.loading.hide();
            this.empty.hide();
            this.enhanced_empty && this.enhanced_empty.hide();
            this.chart_wrapper.show();
            
            // Get document type and create chart
            this.chart_doc.document_type = await this.get_source_doctype();

            if (this.chart_doc.document_type) {
                frappe.model.with_doctype(this.chart_doc.document_type, setup_dashboard_chart);
            } else {
                setup_dashboard_chart();
            }

            this.width == "Full" && this.summary && this.set_summary();
            this.chart_doc.type == "Heatmap" && this.render_heatmap_legend();
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error in render:', error);
            // Fallback to original render
            return await originalRender.call(this);
        }
    };

    // Very conservative empty data check - handles your data structure
    ChartWidget.prototype.isDataCompletelyEmpty = function(data) {
        if (!data) return true;
        
        // Check your specific data structure
        if (data.datasets && Array.isArray(data.datasets)) {
            if (data.datasets.length === 0) return true;
            
            // Check if all datasets are empty (handle both 'data' and 'values' properties)
            const allEmpty = data.datasets.every(dataset => {
                const dataArray = dataset.data || dataset.values;
                return !dataArray || !Array.isArray(dataArray) || dataArray.length === 0;
            });
            
            if (allEmpty) return true;
        }
        
        // Check labels
        if (!data.labels || !Array.isArray(data.labels) || data.labels.length === 0) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check direct data array (for pie, donut)
        if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data) && data.data.length === 0) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check heatmap data
        if (data.start && data.end && data.data && typeof data.data === 'object') {
            return Object.keys(data.data).length === 0;
        }
        
        return false;
    };

    // Enhanced empty state - only shown for truly empty data
    ChartWidget.prototype.showEnhancedEmptyState = function() {
        // Hide original empty state
        if (this.empty) {
            this.empty.hide();
        }
        
        if (!this.enhanced_empty) {
            this.enhanced_empty = $(`
                <div class="chart-no-data-enhanced" style="
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    justify-content: center;
                    height: ${this.height || 240}px;
                    flex-direction: column;
                    color: #8d99a6;
                    font-size: 14px;
                    background: #f8f9fa;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                    margin: 10px 0;
                    border: 1px dashed #dee2e6;
                ">
                    <div style="margin-bottom: 12px; opacity: 0.6;">
                        <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <path d="M3 3l18 18"></path>
                            <path d="M8.5 8.5c-.2-.2-.5-.4-.9-.4C6.4 8.1 5.6 9 5.6 10s.8 1.9 2 1.9c1.3 0 2.4-.8 2.4-2.1 0-.4-.1-.8-.2-1.1"></path>
                            <path d="M15.5 15.5c.2.2.5.4.9.4 1.2 0 2-.9 2-1.9s-.8-1.9-2-1.9c-1.3 0-2.4.8-2.4 2.1 0 .4.1.8.2 1.1"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #6c757d;">
                        No Data Available
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.8; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3;">
                        No data found for the current filters or date range.
                    </div>
                </div>
            `);
            this.enhanced_empty.appendTo(this.body);
        }
        
        this.enhanced_empty.show();
    };

    console.log('ChartWidget patched (targeted fix) - Legend updates enabled without breaking existing charts');
}

// Clean up any previous patches that might interfere
if (frappe.utils.original_make_chart) {
    frappe.utils.make_chart = frappe.utils.original_make_chart;
    delete frappe.utils.original_make_chart;
}
